patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for feature sections, pairing large, evocative product imagery with minimal, elegant text descriptions.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established by contrasting large, elegant serif headings with clean, readable sans-serif body text, conveying sophistication and clarity.

The color palette is predominantly warm and inviting, drawing directly from the product's natural hues (yellows, oranges, peaches), balanced with crisp white and deep charcoal for backgrounds and text.
A persistent top announcement bar and main navigation remain fixed at the top of the viewport, providing continuous access as the user scrolls down the page.
An email signup modal appears after a short scroll depth, overlaying the content with a subtle animation, prompting user engagement.
Product display sections utilize a clean grid layout, featuring large, high-quality product photography with minimal accompanying text, prioritizing visual appeal over detailed descriptions.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header for global navigation and announcements, ensuring these elements are always accessible. A full-screen modal for email signup is triggered after a user scrolls a certain distance, using CSS keyframes for its animated appearance.

Large, full-bleed product photography is central to the design, often serving as background elements or dominant visuals in content sections, creating an immersive and appetizing experience. The hero section features a very tall background image that scrolls slower than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax-like effect as it moves out of view.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established by pairing a sophisticated, large serif font for headlines with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text, ensuring readability while maintaining an elegant brand voice.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (up to ~4x body text) with generous line height, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners for structural elements and images, with very subtle rounding (almost imperceptible) on some product cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and open, with generous padding around content blocks and ample vertical spacing between sections, creating a sense of luxury and focus on individual elements.

standout: The site's distinctive use of product photography as the primary design element, often in full-bleed or oversized formats, creates an immersive and highly appetizing experience. The sophisticated, warm color palette directly derived from the product itself, combined with elegant typography, elevates a simple product like jelly into a luxurious, desirable item.
